headline: Sensex gains over 300 points while Nifty approaches 24,600 supported by IT stocks and sustained FII inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sustained foreign fund inflows boosted market sentiment in early session trading.
IT stocks led the charge, driving gains across major benchmark indices.
Oil price slides helped Indian markets reverse fortunes and buck broader Asian market weakness.
Positive market momentum carried over following a massive 2,000+ point Sensex rally in the prior session.
whatHappening: BSE Sensex jumped 300 to 450 points, while Nifty 50 traded near the 24,600 level.
Nifty Realty index fell 2% and smallcap stocks slid nearly 2%, while India VIX jumped 9.5%.
FADA reported a 23.8% decline in October auto retail sales to 3.172 million units.
The Indian Rupee fell 9 paise to 94.50 against the U.S. dollar in early trade.
summary: Indian benchmark indices traded higher with the Sensex up over 300 points and Nifty approaching 24,600, propelled by IT gains and continuous foreign fund inflows. Meanwhile, real estate and smallcap stocks faced pressure while volatility increased. In corporate news, DLF announced plans to invest ₹3,750 crore in a joint venture with Everstone to acquire a stake in IREO India.
